text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It has arrived... the first milestone...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember what day it is 
today?
choice_data_list: Yes. It's the Upgrade Exam, right?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes, that memorable first time. An 
important one to check on our research 
progress..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
choice_data_list: So you are... nervous after all?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...A little. What if the direction of my 
research and development was wrong to 
begin with...?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
No, we won't know until we try everything. 
Let's all head over to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So the venue is here... Tokyo Racecourse, 
is it?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Going forward, the "Upgrade Exam" 
will be held here.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Because it's ideal for gauging all kinds 
of basic abilities.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We also have the most data on her compared 
to anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The time has come. Then drink it down. 
Poison or medicine, the sweet beginning of 
your trial!"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Allow me to briefly explain the 
experimental procedure.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
A one-on-one race between me and <chrname>, who's 
trained by you. And then—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I'll check the results of the research. 
There shouldn't be any failures, but... I 
must confirm the degree of success.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Of course, if <chrname> runs at full power from the 
very first heat, it won't even be a 
contest. We'll have them hold back a bit.
And so, the very first UGE began—!!
